description: This Java class defines a custom view for rendering a keyboard in the AnySoftKeyboard project. It extends AnyKeyboardView and provides functionality for rendering the keyboard, simulating key presses, and generating bitmaps of the view. It also includes a nested TypingSimulator class for automated key press simulation.

classes.name: DemoAnyKeyboardView
classes.description: A custom view that renders a keyboard without interactivity, capable of simulating key presses and generating bitmaps of itself.

classes.name: DemoAnyKeyboardView.TypingSimulator
classes.description: A handler-based class that simulates typing by sending touch events for characters in a string.

classes.name: DemoAnyKeyboardView.OnViewBitmapReadyListener
classes.description: Interface for callback when the view's bitmap is ready.

methods.name: DemoAnyKeyboardView
methods.description: Constructor initializing the view with context and attributes.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Measures the view size, scaling the keyboard appropriately.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Overrides touch handling to disable interactivity.

methods.name: simulateKeyTouchEvent
methods.description: Simulates a key press or release event for a specific character.

methods.name: setOnViewBitmapReadyListener
methods.description: Sets a listener to be notified when the view bitmap is ready.

methods.name: onLayout
methods.description: Handles layout changes and triggers bitmap generation if needed.

methods.name: generateBitmapFromView
methods.description: Creates a bitmap representation of the view.

methods.name: setSimulatedTypingText
methods.description: Starts or stops simulated typing based on input string.

methods.name: onDetachedFromWindow
methods.description: Cleans up when the view is detached.
